$comment: For each file of invalid/: the path of an issue the parser reports for it, a part of that issue's message, and, for a file only the parser refuses, why the published JSON Schema accepts it. The JSON Schema refuses every other file of invalid/.

wrong-format.json.message: this server reads realm files of format urn:qauth:realm-file:v1-rc.0

unknown-client-field.json.message: "redirect_uri" is not a field of a clients entry

unknown-policy-field.json.message: "accessTokenLifetime" is not a field of policies.tokens

duplicate-client-id.json.message: client_id "notes-web" is listed at clients.0 already
duplicate-client-id.json.why: A natural key listed twice: JSON Schema compares whole items, never one member of them.

system-client-listed-twice.json.message: client_id "system" is listed at clients.0 already
system-client-listed-twice.json.why: The system client takes its default client_id, which JSON Schema cannot compare with the other sections.

jwks-and-jwks-uri.json.why: A rule between two members of a seed-manifest client (RFC 7591 §2), which the parser checks.

url-credentials.json.message: carries a user name or password

url-credentials-lenient.json.message: carries a user name or password
url-credentials-lenient.json.why: A URL parser reads https:/svc:pass@host as a URL with a user name and password, as Node's fetch would; the JSON Schema checks the usual form, scheme://user:pass@host, and an RFC 3986 URI with the user information in its path is one it accepts.

jwks-unknown-member.json.message: "kyes" is not a field of clients.0.jwks
